description: Updates an invoice item on a draft invoice. Use when modifying invoice item properties like amount, description, discounts, or tax settings before invoice finalization.

inputSchema.description: Request model for updating an invoice item.

amount.description: The integer amount in cents of the charge to be applied to the upcoming invoice. To apply a credit, pass a negative value.
amount.title: Amount

description.description: An arbitrary string which you can attach to the invoice item. The description is displayed in the invoice for easy tracking.
description.title: Description

discountable.description: Controls whether discounts apply to this invoice item. Defaults to false for prorations or negative invoice items, and true for all other invoice items.
discountable.title: Discountable

discounts.description: The coupons, promotion codes & existing discounts which apply to the invoice item. Item discounts are applied before invoice discounts. Pass an empty array to remove previously-defined discounts.

items.description: Discount to apply to the invoice item.

coupon.description: ID of the coupon to create a new discount. Mutually exclusive with discount and promotion_code.
coupon.title: Coupon

discount.description: ID of an existing discount to reuse. Mutually exclusive with coupon and promotion_code.
discount.title: Discount

promotion_code.description: ID of the promotion code to apply. Mutually exclusive with coupon and discount.
promotion_code.title: Promotion Code

items.title: DiscountUpdate

discounts.title: Discounts

invoiceitem_id.description: The ID of the invoice item to update. Must start with 'ii_' followed by alphanumeric characters.
invoiceitem_id.title: Invoiceitem Id

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.
metadata.title: Metadata

end.description: End of the period (Unix timestamp in seconds). Must be after the start of the period.
end.title: End

start.description: Start of the period (Unix timestamp in seconds). Must be before or equal to the end of the period.
start.title: Start

price_data.description: Data to create a new price inline.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

product.description: The ID of the product that this price will belong to.
product.title: Product

tax_behavior.description: Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of inclusive, exclusive, or unspecified.
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

unit_amount.description: A positive integer in cents representing how much to charge. One of unit_amount or unit_amount_decimal is required.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Same as unit_amount, but accepts a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places. One of unit_amount or unit_amount_decimal is required.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

price_data.title: PriceDataUpdate

pricing.description: Pricing details for the invoice item.

price.description: The ID of the price object to use for this invoice item.
price.title: Price

pricing.title: PricingUpdate

quantity.description: Non-negative integer. The quantity of units for the invoice item.
quantity.title: Quantity

tax_behavior.description: Only required if a default tax behavior was not provided in the Stripe Tax settings. Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of inclusive, exclusive, or unspecified.
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

tax_rates.description: The tax rates which apply to the invoice item. When set, the default_tax_rates on the invoice do not apply to this invoice item. Pass an empty array to remove previously-defined tax rates.
tax_rates.title: Tax Rates

unit_amount_decimal.description: Same as unit_amount, but accepts a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal
